simple.meaning: שְׁאָט (shᵉʼâṭ) is a Hebrew word meaning “contempt.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שְׁאָט (H7589) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezekiel 25:6, with occurrences in Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׁאָט (H7589) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שְׁאָט (H7589) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שְׁאָט (shᵉʼâṭ) / H7589 is traced through Ezekiel 25:6, Ezekiel 25:15, Ezekiel 36:5 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
